page: Vultr voc-s-16c-128gb-2560s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an AMD EPYC processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of a 2560 GB NVMe SSD, while GPU hardware is entirely absent.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong memory performance, with large block write bandwidth placing in the top tier (top 10%) and large block read bandwidth in the top 25%. The Passmark memory score and stress-ng single-core CPU performance also rank in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, static web serving throughput, and Redis SET operations perform within the average range (middle 50%). LLM inference speeds for small and medium models similarly align with average tier expectations.

Given its high memory density of 8 GB per vCPU and substantial 2.5 TB NVMe SSD storage, this server offers a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. It is well-suited for database hosting, memory-cached applications, data processing pipelines, and general-purpose enterprise workloads requiring a balance of high memory capacity and fast local storage.
